evidence_title: A.R.S. § 32-1501 Definitions (naturopathic medicine)

evidence_title: Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code § 3640.5 (California.Public.Law statute text)

evidence_quote: Obtaining, dispensing, administering, ordering, or prescribing, as specified, medicines listed in the naturopathic formulary, which includes: (A) Epinephrine to treat anaphylaxis; (B) Barrier contraceptives
notes: Narrow formulary (epinephrine, B6/B12, vaccines, OTC substances, additions by director).

evidence_title: Conn. Gen. Stat. ch. 373, § 20-34 Practice defined (naturopathy)

evidence_title: D.C. Code title 3, ch. 12 § 3-1206.21 Scope of practice (naturopathic medicine)
